title: Switching admin_full_access off through POST /security/_activation is accepted for the last platform admin, and nothing in the product can switch it back on
body:
qa#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibw6yXcLi9aRRBpPT4W

## Reproduction (stock showcase, single posture, `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL` unset, fresh file DB; reproduced 3 times at 8e3d4a54 and once at 18.3.0)

1. Boot `objectstack dev --seed-admin`. The seeded admin `admin@objectos.ai` is the only holder of `admin_full_access` (one `sys_user_permission_set` row); `GET /api/v1/auth/me/permissions` lists positions `platform_admin, org_owner, …` and the set `admin_full_access`.
2. As that admin: `POST /api/v1/security/_activation/permission/admin_full_access` body `{"enabled":false}` → **200** `{type:"permission", name:"admin_full_access", enabled:false}`.
3. `GET /api/v1/auth/me/permissions` → `platform_admin` and `admin_full_access` are gone, and with them `manage_metadata` (left: the showcase sets, `organization_admin_no_bypass`, `member_default`, …). A fresh sign-in reads the same.
4. `POST /api/v1/security/_activation/permission/admin_full_access` body `{"enabled":true}` → **403** PERMISSION_DENIED "Enabling or disabling a permission set requires the `manage_metadata` capability …".
5. Other doors are closed too: `PATCH /api/v1/data/sys_metadata_activation/:id {active:true}` → 405 OBJECT_API_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED; `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/…` → 403.

## Expected vs actual

- Expected: step 2 is refused. `packages/runtime/src/domains/catalog-activation.ts` says "the last-admin guard refuses switching `admin_full_access` off (ADR-0135 D5.2)", and the last-admin guard's shape (4) refuses the change "wherever the grant remains the load-bearing anchor".
- Actual: the switch-off lands, and the deployment has no in-product way back (database surgery or a re-seed).

## Mechanism (read, not proven)

`resolveAdminUserIds` appears to count the organization owner (`sys_member` role `owner`) as a remaining administrator, so the guard sees one admin left. Under `single` posture that owner's `organization_admin_no_bypass` carries no `manage_metadata`, the only capability that can switch the set back on.

## Not a regression

18.3.0 (83d7e4ae, stock showcase, fresh DB) answers steps 2–4 identically. Only an entitled admin can do this, and only to themselves; no privilege is gained.
